zh-CN.name: LobeChat
zh-CN.summary: 开源多 Agent 协作工作空间，支持多模型和插件
zh-CN.description: LobeChat 是一个开源的多 Agent 协作工作空间，支持多模型服务提供商（OpenAI / Claude / Gemini / Ollama 等），多模态和可扩展的插件系统。一键免费部署私有 ChatGPT/Claude 应用。

en-US.name: LobeChat
en-US.summary: Open-source multi-agent collaboration workspace with multi-model and plugin support
en-US.description: LobeChat is an open-source multi-agent collaboration workspace that supports multiple model providers (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, and more), multimodal interactions, and an extensible plugin system. It enables one-click deployment of private ChatGPT or Claude applications.
